title: 2014 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Horse
seo_title: 2014 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Horse (31 January – 18 February 2015)
description: 2014 is the Year of the Wood Horse (Yang, Jia-wu), from 31 January 2014 to 18 February 2015. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2014.
lead: Born in 2014? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Horse, but check the date: the 2014 Wood Horse year began on 31 January 2014. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2014: Year of the Wood Horse, from 31 January 2014 to 18 February 2015.

image.alt: Golden Horse of the Chinese zodiac in front of a moonlit temple
image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2014 was the Year of the Horse. It began with Lunar New Year on 31 January 2014 and ended on 18 February 2015, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2014 ends in 4, which makes it a Wood year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2014 is a Jia-wu year. The same Wood Horse combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1954 before it and 2074 after it.
Lunar New Year 2014 fell on 31 January 2014. Anyone born from 1 January 2014 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Snake; from 31 January 2014 on, the Horse.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Horse guide describes the sign like this: “Energetic, independent, and adventurous. Horses love freedom and new experiences.” The usual watch-out: “Can be impatient or struggle to commit long-term.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Horse page.
Careers often linked with the Horse: travel, sales, sports, media.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2014
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Horse's best matches are the Tiger, Goat and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Horse, 2026 is a Horse year, so Horse people are in their own year (ben ming nian) until 5 February 2027.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Horse, it is listed as a supportive match of the Goat, so 2027 is traditionally a friendly year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Horse years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1990 (Metal Horse); 2002 (Water Horse); 2026 (Fire Horse); 2038 (Earth Horse). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2014 is the Year of the Horse, a Yang Wood Horse year (Jia-wu).
When does the 2014 Year of the Horse start and end?
It starts on 31 January 2014 and ends on 18 February 2015.
I was born in January 2014. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 31 January 2014, you are a Snake; from 31 January 2014 on, a Horse.
Wood. 2014 ends in 4, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Horse compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Goat and Dog. The Horse's clash sign is the Rat.
